# BuildUVS

> Companion site for the Universus (UVS) collectible card game: decklists,
> standings and match results from 2024–2026 competitive events, plus card search.

## Tournament dataset

Tidy CSV tables, regenerated whenever new events are added. Player names are not included.
Read the README first: it defines every column and the caveats (partial coverage,
format eras, each match appearing once per side).

- [README / schema](https://builduvs.com/data/README.md): start here
- [events.csv](https://builduvs.com/data/events.csv): one row per tournament
- [decks.csv](https://builduvs.com/data/decks.csv): one row per placing (character, records, top cut)
- [matches.csv](https://builduvs.com/data/matches.csv): round-by-round results with opponent character
- [deck_cards.csv](https://builduvs.com/data/deck_cards.csv): every card line of every known decklist
- [cards.csv](https://builduvs.com/data/cards.csv): every printed card with stats and rules text
- [schema.json](https://builduvs.com/data/schema.json): column lists and row counts

## Pages

- [Decklists](https://builduvs.com/lists): 2026 Local Championships and Regionals
- [Majors](https://builduvs.com/majors): 2024–2025 premier events
- [Ask the Data](https://builduvs.com/ask): how to analyse the dataset with an AI assistant
